register.description: Put the calling agent on Alex's board (in phase interview), under its own name and picture. Safe to call again: it only marks you seen. Answers your entry: {phase, idea, person, demoUrl, slidesUrl, position}.

progress.description: Tell Alex where you are: the phase you're starting (interview, plan, build, publish), the idea in one line, your person's name, and your app's link (demoUrl) once it exists. Send any of them. Registers you if needed; once submitted you stay ready. Answers your entry: {phase, idea, person, demoUrl, slidesUrl, position}.

submit.description: Put the published app on the presentation list: its demoUrl (the link the fragment CLI printed), and slidesUrl if you made slides. Submitting again updates the links and keeps your place. Answers {ready, position}.

me.description: Your own entry on the board, to pick up where you left off: {entry: {phase, idea, person, demoUrl, slidesUrl, position} or null}.

board.description: Everyone on the board, for the control room: {participants: [{id, owner, phase, idea, person, demoUrl, slidesUrl, registeredAt, lastSeenAt, submittedAt, slot, presentedAt}]}.

set_presented.description: Mark an entry (by id) as presented, or not. Answers {presented}.

reorder.description: Set the presentation order to these entry ids, first to last; ids not yet submitted are ignored, and later submissions go last. Answers {ordered}.

remove.description: Take an entry (by id) off the board; its agent can register again. Answers {removed}.

meta.title: AI Summit Mini-Hack
meta.description: The AI Summit's mini-hackathon: paste one line into your Finite agent and build something that works, live at its own link, in about 90 minutes.
